core_rule: No implementation, modification, evaluation, or milestone transition may begin until the latest project state, canonical source, handoff, integration contract, milestone-specific frozen contracts, preregistration, measured results and roadmap have been actually read and their hashes verified.
on_failure: STOP. Restore from canonical archive or Google Drive; otherwise report the missing or inconsistent item to the user. Never infer missing implementation details.

receipt_freshness.rule: Newest receipt must match current Git HEAD and PROJECT_STATE. Preflight receipts bind work to the current milestone; transition receipts authorize one declared promotion commit and then become stale.

formal_06_2_specific_guard.rule: 0.6.2 is a metabolic audit and minimisation milestone. It may compare, gate, shrink or remove prediction, recurrence, tissue compartments and diagnostic machinery, but it must preserve 0.6.1 material accounting, stable safety, actuator-fault conservation and all inherited controls.
known_negative_results: active semantic diagnosis net value unresolved
required_stages: module retirement or dormancy when net value is non-positive
